name: memcode
description: The single rotating member code (docs/specs/member-code.md): the 19-character token and its Crockford REF, the TOTP arithmetic of ON and OFF, the step clock a clockless board counts on, the per-day key ring, the replay ring, and the offline verifier. Knows nothing about courts, doors or relays. No Arduino headers, no heap; compiles for AVR, Xtensa and host.
